_note: Higgsfield (GPT Image, gpt_image_2_6) job of each reference picture of the hall's inside (v26.18). The picture is masters/v26.0/props/refs/<name>-2k.png (first batch) or <name>-1k.png (second batch: a draft made at 1k), its copy <name>-1024.jpg committed. Words: props/PROMPTS.py, 'the hall's inside (v26.18)'. Crops that went in as image references: props/crops_hallin.py (objects only: no person, no face, no lettering, no sacred image; each opened and looked at first). `made` is the quality and size each was made at and `credits` what it cost: NOTHING was made at max (16 Nov 2026: 30 credits in hand, a max/2k picture is 9), so a redraw at max/2k of any of them is a known step with the same words. `look` is what the picture was judged to be, opened at its full size against the photographs; `verdict` (second batch) is 'good as it is' (its words and its crops need no change) or 'draw again' (with what to change). EVERY second-batch picture is a low-quality 1k draft: with credits in hand each is drawn at high/2k (2.75; the naga pieces at max, 9) with its words before its model is made, a picture being 2.75 credits against a model's 45.
